description: Long notes + sub-pattern + year_plus + very_broken sleep + 2 med flags. All +1 triggers fire → target 7.

input.notes: Postpartum, second baby, deep hormonal-emotional-sleep hole. Prior herb use: passionflower did nothing, ashwagandha helped for a month then plateaued. Really need something that holds the whole weave — mood, sleep, hormonal reset all at once.

herbs.name: Ashwagandha
herbs.botanical: Withania somnifera (root — 2–3 year matured, standardised to 5% withanolides)

herbs.name: Red Dates
herbs.botanical: Ziziphus jujuba (whole dried fruit — "Chinese Red Date / Jujube")

herbs.name: Longan
herbs.botanical: Dimocarpus longan / Euphoria longana (dried aril — Long Yan Rou)

herbs.name: Fu Ling
herbs.botanical: Wolfiporia cocos (syn. Poria cocos) (sclerotium — "White Stone of Stillness")

herbs.name: Reishi
herbs.botanical: Ganoderma lucidum (fruiting body, mycelium and spores — "Mushroom of Immortality / Lingzhi")

herbs.name: Lion's Mane
herbs.botanical: Hericium erinaceus (fruiting body and mycelium — "Neuron Awakener")

herbs.name: Oatstraw
herbs.botanical: Avena sativa (aerial parts — sterile stem and milky oat tops)

synergies.note: Reishi and Oatstraw — grounding, nourishing, deeply balancing formula
